episode.title: The Boring Trick That Doubles Your Money

scenes.narration: Everyone loves a get rich quick scheme. Math prefers patience.
Invest five hundred dollars a month at seven percent, and after thirty years you hold about six hundred thousand dollars.
scenes.label: $500/month at 7% for 30 years

scenes.narration: Of that, you only put in one hundred eighty thousand. The rest is growth.
And look how late the curve takes off.
Most of the money arrives in the last ten years, which is why starting early matters so much.

items: Do not touch it in a panic

scenes.narration: Boring on purpose. That is the whole trick.
